description.narrative: SMEs and SHFs improved on quality standards to meet the requirements of premium off-takers both local and international markets. ToT conducted by EWS to 4 IDH agronomists on best horticultural practices and developing the business case for horticultural production. The step-down training was conducted by IDH Agronomists to SMEs and their smallholder farmers. The activities conducted included proper nursery development, different platforms for nursery development, seeding procedures, crop protection and many more. ToT conducted by HGT for IDH agronomists on horticulture irrigation facility installation. Through the partnership between IDH and HGT 3 demo facilities have been established in North-East, Upper East and Upper West Region. 3 IDH SMEs (Tamana, Agriaccess and U3 Agrinet with over 150 SHFs were trained on GAPs, quality standards and protocols of horticulture production. ToT has been conducted in 6 regions of Ghana. In all 15 horticulture demos established located in 6 regions with 15 SMEs and 150 smallholder farmers managing the fields. SMEs and SHFs taken through the changing market dynamics and demands of some specific horticultural commodities
